baslik: Why Six Inches of Water Can Kill You
aciklama:
Floodwater looks harmless but has more force than most people imagine. Here is why it is so deadly.

#shorts #science #flood #safety #nature

sahneler.metin: Six inches of moving water can knock a grown adult over.
Floodwater looks gentle, but water is incredibly heavy.
A foot of it can lift and carry away most cars.
You cannot see what is under the surface either.
The road might be gone, hiding a deadly drop.
The water is often full of sewage, chemicals, and debris.
And it rises far faster than people expect.
Most flood deaths happen inside vehicles.
The rule is simple - turn around, do not drown.
